name: 2023 10 04 October PC Agenda
agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING AGENDA
October 4, 2023 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard
----------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minutes approval  for  September  6,  2023,  Planning  Commission
  meetings.

6.  PUBLIC HEARING:
  a. A public hearing to consider Zoning Code Amendment No. 23-00006
  (ZCA23-00006) to establish Accessory Dwelling Unit Regulations
  in Chapter 12 of the Inglewood Municipal Code, Citywide.

  This item has been postponed to the November 1, 2023 Planning
  Commission meeting.

7.  NON-PUBLIC HEARING:
  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Deborah Han,
  representing Kaiser Permanente, for Design Review No. 23-00037
  (DR23-00037) to allow a proposed mural and exterior alterations
  on an approximately 63,400 square-foot 4-story commercial
  building, on an H-C (Historic Core)zoned property at 110 North
  La Brea Avenue.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2023-101; and
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving DR23-00037 subject to
  8 conditions and/or add conditions as deemed appropriate.
  Item 7a Documents

  b. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Sabrina
  Barnes, representing the City of Inglewood, for Planning
  Commission Review No. 23-00014 (PCR23-00014) to allow the
  installation of a new 437 square-foot one-story restroom
  building in Edward Vincent, Jr. Park on an O-S (Open Space)
  zoned property at 700 East Warren Lane.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2023-102; and
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving PCR23-00014 subject
  to 6 conditions and/or add conditions as deemed appropriate.
  Item 7b Documents

8.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

9.  Commission Initiatives.

10.  Adjournment.
 If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of October 4, 2023,
is not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda
item being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda
item will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning
Commission meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 1, 2023, 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
